claude_proposed_widenings.name: succeed_on_save
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring's core mechanic converts a failed saving throw into a success after the roll is resolved. No existing EffectAtom models a post-roll failure override. modify_roll_advantage applies before rolling; modify_roll_numeric adds a delta (not guaranteed success); neither can represent 'you succeed instead'. This is a distinct post-resolution override atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reaction trigger condition on ActivatedAbilityMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spell reactions carry a ReactionTrigger on CastingTime (hit_by_attack_roll, targeted_by_named_spell, creature_casts_spell). Non-spell activations using activationCost { kind: 'reaction' } have no equivalent field to constrain when the reaction may fire. The Ring of Evasion's reaction is only legal when the wearer fails a Dexterity saving throw — this condition is currently not expressible on ActivatedAbilityMechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead.
